body.content: Conjecture: the optimal configuration for n=13 in the unit square has a minimum triangle area between 0.038 and 0.045. Upper bound argument: by the pigeonhole principle, among 13 points in [0,1]^2, at least 4 must share a horizontal strip of height 1/3. Among these 4 points, the minimum triangle has base ≤ 1/3 and height ≤ 1/3, giving area ≤ 1/18 ~ 0.056. But the stagger constraint and the need to fill the square reduce this further. The 4x3 staggered grid achieves 0.0385, which may be within a factor of 1.5 of optimal.
body.possible_next_move: Search for configurations that break the 4-per-strip bound by using non-strip-aligned distributions.
body.why_keep_this: Provides a theoretical bound context for evaluating whether candidates are near-optimal or if significant improvement is possible.
